required_actions.instruction: Permit outbound TCP 443 with TLS verification to dns.google (bootstrap 8.8.8.8) and use-land-property-data.service.gov.uk for the bounded four-byte endpoint receipt validation only.
Send the prepared INSPIRE endpoint access-failure draft to data.services@mail.landregistry.gov.uk or call 0300 006 0478, Monday to Friday 9am to 5pm; published response target is 2 working days.
